verdict_word: Missed on loss and revenue, guide reaffirmed
takeaways: Loss of $0.44 a share was wider than the $0.40 FactSet expected (MarketWatch); revenue of $42.3 million missed $45.7 million.
It kept 2026 revenue guidance at $150-200 million and still targets initial intermittent nationwide U.S. service before year-end.
New: Blacklift, its own 20-ton reusable rocket planned from late 2028, plus a $1.0 billion non-dilutive funding award from Japan's communications ministry.
Plans to reach over 100 BlueBird satellites deployed during 2027 and 2028; Q4 capex guide is $400-500 million.
The stock jumped 14.1% in Monday's session before the report (Investing.com).
verdict: AST missed on both lines and announced it's building its own rocket, which is the most AST thing possible. Fans heard 'nationwide service by year-end' and 'a billion dollars from Japan'; accountants heard 'wider loss.' Both are right.
